name: calories
description: A private, per-account calorie and macro diary synced across web, desktop, and mobile, with AI photo identification, barcode lookups, goals, reminders, charts, and friend challenges.

interface.shortDescription: Track calories, macros, weight, and challenges with friends.
interface.longDescription: Install it for your own account; no organization needed and nobody else sees your diary. Log meals by photo, barcode, search, or hand on the web, desktop, or mobile app; set calorie and macro goals; get reminders; watch 30-day calorie and weight charts; and invite friends by username to weight-loss and logging-streak challenges.
defaultPrompt: How many calories have I logged today?
Who is leading our weight-loss challenge?
Remind me to log lunch at 12:30.
